profile.name: Rajeev Sachan
profile.title: Android Developer
profile.tagline: Impact-driven Android Developer specializing in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, building scalable, high-performance apps that turn user and business needs into measurable outcomes.

summary.primary: I chose Android development because seeing code transform into a real, usable experience felt magical. What started as curiosity quickly became passion as I realized I could build products people use in their everyday lives. Over time, I grew from fixing small bugs to owning complete features and delivering scalable solutions. Today, I build high-performance Android applications serving 50+ million users on the Play Store. 🚀
summary.secondary:
Outside of Android, I’m usually exploring new places 🌍 — 16 states and counting — collecting memories (and too many photos).
In office breaks, it’s strictly table tennis 🏓, and after office, I switch to badminton 🏸 — because apparently being competitive is a full-time personality trait.
At home, I cook Indian food 👨🍳 while vibing to Punjabi music 🎶, occasionally reading something to feel intellectual 📚 — and if I’m doing absolutely nothing… I’m probably overthinking it anyway. 😌

featured_work.industry: Global Sports Streaming Platform delivering live and on-demand sports content across multiple countries.
key_contributions: Refactored the entire Sports Home section from XML to Jetpack Compose, modernizing UI architecture and improving performance while supporting dynamic UI.
Built a Generic Paywall system for premium rights (FIBA, NFL).
Optimized Chromecast integration using Cast SDK.
Wrote comprehensive Unit/UI tests using Mockito, MockK & Espresso.

featured_work.industry: EdTech platform serving 10M+ users with government exam preparation and learning solutions.
key_contributions: Launched SkillAcademy app from scratch, built Assignment module and Account Blocking flow features, and migrated legacy codebase to SDK 33 across modules.
Built Assignment module & Account blocking flow.
Migrated legacy codebase to SDK 33 across modules.
Used Jetpack Compose & Clean Architecture for scalability.
